paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 42:3; in Midrash Tehillim 119:3 R' Yehudah HaLevi bar Shalom speaks in his name.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Midrash Rabbah TE Shemot Rabbah 42:3 paragraph fully names Rabbi Chaggai ben Elazar, supporting the local heading title. The Midrash Tehillim 119:3 transmission was not freshly collated, so its abbreviated Yehudah HaLevi bar Shalom title remains R'. Hyman’s report-in-his-name direction and both locators remain without a new identity or teacher binding.
